text: Correction to the claims citing test:trunion.io/pawl/internal/e2e.TestSampleVerdictAndMechanicalVerdictAreSeparateFields. That test no longer exists: review established it asserted over a struct literal and exercised neither production path, so it was replaced by TestSamplingLeavesTheSampleVerdictUnsetAndTheMechanicalVerdictIntact and TestRecordingAReviewDoesNotOverwriteTheMechanicalVerdict, both of which fail under mutation. The earlier claims cite a test that cannot resolve and stay on the record unaltered; C-10's checkable field now points at the two replacements.
